races.display_title: Fairlight Studios Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Having made a promising start over hurdles, TRALEE GIRL hasn't been at her best in 2 outings this year but she's well worth another chance returning from a break for her leading yard. You Be Lucky Jean was successful both starts in bumpers and is feared most, while Mia Sunshine is respected given her ability on the Flat. TRALEE GIRL (IRE) YOU BE LUCKY JEAN MIA SUNSHINE (GER)

races.display_title: MW Civils & Groundworks Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Given another try over fences, JETEYE opened his chase account at the third attempt at Cartmel in July before not seen to best effect over this C&D last time. He is taken to resume winning ways in a change of headgear, with Aill Dubh the pick for second having been in good heart prior to his latest effort. JETEYE (IRE) AILL DUBH (IRE) BAHTIYAR (FR)

races.display_title: Bill & Teresa Florentines 50th Anniversary Handicap Chase
